title: North Korea's Kim calls for diversified use of tactical nuclear weapons

blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea — North Korean leader Kim Jong Un said his country should diversify its use of tactical nuclear weapons, state media reported Thursday, stressing that its nuclear capabilities had become a “reality.” Kim made the remarks during an inspection of a nuclear weapons research facility at an undisclosed location on Wednesday, following repeated declarations that Pyongyang would not abandon its nuclear weapons. “The nuclear weapons manufacturing sector should pay attention to utilizing tactical nukes with different missions in multiple domains,” the official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) quoted him as saying, without elaborating.
